name: game-standalone-views
goal: Generated 2D and 3D games follow authored view transitions and restore per-view checkpoint progress.

evidence: The generated page binds document.views[0] permanently; transition actions change state.view but the UI never enters that view. The engine and authoring workspace already support enterView progress restoration.

The CLI matrix fetched SSR HTML only, and standalone image acceptance played one view. Extend those existing cases to run the browser against generated source and bundled CLI projects, enter a second view and return with the first checkpoint image restored.
